senses.gloss:
शौष्कल शौष्कल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. शुष्कली),
eating fish and flesh; (अस्), m. an habitual eater of
meat; a vender of flesh, dealer in flesh or dried
meat; (अम्), n. the price of dried meat.

सौशील्य सौशील्य, अम्, n. (fr. सु-शील), ex-
cellence of disposition, good morals.

सौश्रवस सौश्रवस, अम्, n. (fr. सु-श्रवस्),
celebrity, renown; (अस्), m. a patronymic.

सौश्रुत सौश्रुत, आस्, m. pl. (fr. सु-श्रुत),
N. of a family descended from Viśvā-mitra.

सौषद्मन सौषद्मन, अस्, m. (fr. सु-षद्-
मन्), a patronymic.

सौष्ठव सौष्ठव, अम्, n. (fr. सु-ष्ठु), ex-
cellence, superior goodness or beauty, extreme skil-
fulness, cleverness; excess (of anything); lightness,
suppleness, fleetness, a particular division of dramatic
composition.

सौस्नातिक सौस्नातिक, अस्, m. (fr. सु-स्नात),
one who asks whether an ablution has been success-
ful or auspicious.
